privacy.redaction_policy: Only sanitized command names, exit codes, and root-cause summaries are recorded.

errors.observed_error: Referenced root governance files and validators were missing.
errors.root_cause: The test contract was added before all referenced governance artifacts were created.
errors.fix: Created the module dependency, project data boundary, supply-chain artifacts and validators.
errors.repeat_prevention: Root tests must check referenced file existence before behavior assertions; the root gate must run after artifact creation.

errors.observed_error: The combined test invocation failed without isolating the failing test boundary.
errors.root_cause: A broad command was used before splitting the failure by module and contract layer.
errors.fix: Ran Task Ledger, Observer, Client Neutral Manifest and core-schema tests as separate focused commands, then reran discovery.
errors.repeat_prevention: When an aggregate test fails, the workflow must preserve the original output and automatically split by test file before changing code.
errors.remaining_boundary: The aggregate result is local evidence, not cloud CI evidence.

errors.observed_error: CORE_SCHEMA_CONTRACT_FAIL: forbidden key token in task-ledger schema.
errors.root_cause: The budget field name collided with the global sensitive-key denylist.
errors.fix: Renamed the budget field to tokens across the Ledger implementation, schema, tests and verifier expectations.
errors.repeat_prevention: Scan new schema keys against the global denylist before implementation and require positive/negative schema controls.
errors.remaining_boundary: No live provider or runtime state was inspected.

errors.observed_error: Tests referenced a production export that did not yet exist; one sensitive-key assertion also used the wrong case.
errors.root_cause: The test contract was written without first confirming the production export and exact runtime error text.
errors.fix: Added the production analytics schema/sink export and corrected the case-sensitive assertion.
errors.repeat_prevention: Before adding a test, the author must resolve the production symbol and call path; assertions must use observed behavior rather than guessed spelling.
errors.remaining_boundary: Real platform analytics was not exercised.

errors.observed_error: The historical verifier path did not exist in the current repository.
errors.root_cause: An outdated task instruction was executed without checking the current filesystem and supported V3 entrypoints.
errors.fix: Enumerated real files and switched to verify_product_manifest_v3.py, verify_runtime_contracts_v3.py, verify_visual_scoring_v3.py and verify_visual_quality_v21.py.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every command must pass an entrypoint preflight: exact file exists, current working directory, help/arguments and module owner.
errors.remaining_boundary: Live Open Design E3 registration remains pending.

errors.observed_error: The restoration command ran under the wrong working directory and returned pathspec errors.
errors.root_cause: The test command's nested workdir was assumed to persist for a root-relative recovery command; the original test exit code also masked the recovery failure.
errors.fix: Checked pwd and root git status, reran git restore from WORK-LAB root, and verified module status plus diff check separately.
errors.repeat_prevention: Recovery commands must independently check their exit code and run from an explicitly verified repository root; never use a final exit-code variable that hides cleanup failure.
errors.remaining_boundary: No generated-file recovery is evidence of a release build.

errors.observed_error: Task counts were manually updated at different times and could drift from per-task states; the final Ledger fingerprint edit also occurred after the last full suite.
errors.root_cause: Evidence summaries were treated as authoritative instead of being derived from the canonical task map and final-tree verification.
errors.fix: Added this canonical error ledger and required machine validation of fields, counts, evidence levels and remaining boundaries.
errors.repeat_prevention: The workflow must recompute counts from task_status, must run a narrow regression after every post-suite edit, and must rerun the affected full gate before updating the baseline.
errors.remaining_boundary: The fingerprint focused test and affected full Workflow suite now pass; cloud CI and Git delivery remain separate boundaries.

errors.root_cause: The tests directory is not a Python package, so module-name unittest loading is not a supported entrypoint.
errors.fix: Used file-based discovery from the module root: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_workflow_governance.py.
errors.repeat_prevention: Focused Python tests in non-package directories must use file-based discovery or direct file execution; module-name loading must not be used without package markers.
errors.remaining_boundary: This validates the local test entrypoint only; it does not prove cloud CI.

errors.observed_error: dataclasses import failed with NoneType.__dict__ during direct importlib loading.
errors.root_cause: The focused test loader did not register the dynamically created module in sys.modules before execution.
errors.fix: Registered the module under spec.name before calling exec_module.
errors.repeat_prevention: Dynamic import tests must register the module in sys.modules before executing code that introspects __module__.
errors.remaining_boundary: The conformance adapter is an isolated fake and does not prove a real client adapter.

errors.observed_error: VERIFY_ORDER contained adapter-conformance but the test tuple expected the previous gate sequence.
errors.root_cause: Adding a canonical gate changed the production order without synchronizing the governance assertion.
errors.fix: Updated the expected VERIFY_ORDER tuple to include adapter-conformance.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every new quality gate must update the runner, VERIFY_ORDER, root workflow wiring and order assertions together.
errors.remaining_boundary: The local full suite does not prove a remote GitHub Actions run.

errors.observed_error: run_quality_gate list output included adapter-conformance but the expected output substring did not.
errors.root_cause: The human-readable gate listing assertion was not synchronized with the newly canonical gate.
errors.fix: Updated the expected gate listing substring to include adapter-conformance.
errors.repeat_prevention: Gate additions require updating both machine order assertions and rendered list assertions.
errors.remaining_boundary: The rendered list is local contract evidence, not CI execution evidence.

errors.observed_error: The verifier was invoked from the Workflow module directory and the relative root script path did not exist.
errors.root_cause: The command workdir was not aligned with the repository-root entrypoint.
errors.fix: Reran the same verifier from WORK-LAB root after confirming the exact path.
errors.repeat_prevention: Root-level CI verifiers must run from an explicitly verified repository root or use an absolute path.
errors.remaining_boundary: This verifies the local error ledger only; it does not prove the root GitHub job executed.

errors.observed_error: MODULE_DEPENDENCIES_FAIL modules must exactly match the three canonical modules.
errors.root_cause: The v1 verifier hard-coded minigame as an active module and rejected the v2 Observer module and observed-by relation.
errors.fix: Updated canonical module IDs, path classifier, dependency types, and root tests for work-lab-observer; legacy minigame remains archive-only.
errors.repeat_prevention: Active module registries must derive from the current task-pack architecture and reject retired product trees as active modules.
errors.remaining_boundary: No live Observer or Tauri runtime was executed.

errors.root_cause: The reused visual-quality schema predated the v2 catalog requirement for canonical schema IDs.
errors.fix: Added the canonical work-lab/visual-qa-report/v1 $id without creating a second visual QA schema.
errors.repeat_prevention: Every schema added to the catalog must be checked for JSON Schema validity and a non-empty canonical $id.
errors.remaining_boundary: Schema validation does not prove live cross-module producer/consumer traffic.

errors.observed_error: The manifest test expected 10 schemas while the v2 Workflow manifest declared 13.
errors.root_cause: The production schema registry was expanded before the legacy exact-count assertion was synchronized.
errors.fix: Updated the test to assert the v2 core schema count of 13 and reran the full Workflow suite.
errors.repeat_prevention: Schema additions must update production manifest, verifier expectations, tests, and root catalog in one change set.
errors.remaining_boundary: The full result is local evidence; remote CI remains unrun.

errors.observed_error: Remote checkout could not find the ignored local error ledger required by the integration gate.
errors.root_cause: The verifier consumed a .hermes task artifact that is intentionally not version controlled, so fresh CI had no canonical input.
errors.fix: Moved the sanitized canonical ledger to 50-taskpacks/error-ledger.json and changed the verifier to use the tracked path; the ignored artifact remains local evidence only.
errors.repeat_prevention: Canonical CI inputs must be tracked or explicitly provisioned; never require an ignored runtime artifact in a fresh checkout.
errors.remaining_boundary: The next exact-SHA CI run must verify the repaired integration and aggregate jobs.

errors.observed_error: Remote aggregate reported missing_or_failed minigame after workflow, open-design, observer and integration all succeeded.
errors.root_cause: The v1 aggregate gate still required the retired minigame job instead of the v2 observer job.
errors.fix: Changed the canonical required job set to workflow, open-design, observer and integration and added positive/negative regression tests.
errors.repeat_prevention: Any module job rename must update the aggregate required set, workflow payload, root tests and exact-SHA CI readback together.
errors.remaining_boundary: A new exact-SHA CI run must confirm aggregate success after this fix.
